title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

If any discrepancy is noticed by the student in the concerned details then it should be immediately reported to Mr. Manjinder in 32-803 latest by 10th September, 2014 along with relevant documents for updation of the record. title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: Certificate Course in ANDROID AND C#.NET under Lovely Skills Development Centre. (9/2/2014)

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

This recognition is surely deserved and will give you an opportunity to spread your wings. Congratulations on making your family & University proud by securing placement in Cognizant Technology Solutions. 610 gems of our University will now sparkle the offices of CTS and I am very positive that you will stand out and excel as Brand Ambassadors of your own Lovely Professional University. Now it is your responsibility to focus more on your remaining academic activities and stand by your friends and colleagues who are still seeking Placements. Their success will taste sweeter to you than your own. To celebrate this success, lets be together and have a grand celebration !! I am planning a get together for you all, information regarding which would be shared by tomorrow ! Once again I congratulate you on your wonderful achievement. Bless You ALL !!! Pro Chancellor

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

title: SQL Server Certificate Course under Lovely Center for Skills Development (11/10/2014)
body: Note: 1.Last chance to register. Only few days left for registration. 2.Last date of registration is 10th November, 2014. 3.Classes will not be held during ETE and Winter Vacation. Two Certificates will be provided:- a. One for the participation in the SQL Server Certificate Course. b. One after clearing the exam and securing at least 40% marks in the same. This is for the information of all the students and faculty/staff members that Lovely Skills Development Centre will be starting a certificate course on MS SQL Server in second week of Nov, 14. SQL Server Certificate Course This course will be covering the concepts of SQL Server as a RDBMS and its growing use in the industry. MS SQL Server has gained lot of market in the major corporations because of its ease of use, scalability, good support and Business Intelligence tools. The certificate course on SQL Server will be taught from the career prospect of MS SQL Developer and the course contents includes topics like: SQL Server Installation, SQL queries, Data types, Group by and having clause, Joins, Sub Queries, Indexes, Views Meaning and it creation, Correlated Sub Queries, PL/SQL, Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Table Valued Functions, Scalar Functions, Aggregate Functions, Common Table Expressions, Pivoting, XML with Database, SQL CLR. NET Integration, Working with Temp Databases, Creation of Users, Login, Backups, Restorations, SQL Server Integration Services, How SQL Server Differs from Oracle Database, Writing custom database scripts that does pivoting, XML pivoting, grouped data etc. An Introduction to SQL Server Reporting Services to create customized reports. How SQL Server Differentiates from Oracle, NoSQL. Time: 5 - 6 pm Duration: 2 months Classes: Monday - Saturday Prerequisite: None Start Date of Classes: 10th Nov, 2014 Resource Person: Rohit Dhand For more information on fees and registration, please contact Ms. Rajni (98727-76434) at 30-405 Uploaded By: Rohit Dhand Division of Infotech

body: The programme is organized to enhance the presentation skills in scientific domain Content: An Initiation from Domain of Microbiology and Immunology, Department of Biotechnology, Biosciences (SBS) Topic: Microorganisms as therapeutic agents The student has to submit a write up of 250 words, Specifying the areas like • Source of microorganism, • Reasons for considering therapeutic agents, • recent advancement in research, • where they are being used, • mode of action, • Pros and cons of usage of such an organism as a therapeutic agent. The proposal is open for all students of Biosciences (SBS). Process of selection of students: All the interested student can submit the write up (250 words) by 14.09.2011, out of which 5 students are going to be selected for presentation on the same, on 19.09.2011 after screening process. title: Guidelines for Industrial Training Evaluation of B.Sc Hotel Management & B.Sc Airlines,Tourism & Hospitality -Final Reminder (8/3/2011)
body: Dear Students, This is to inform you that please find below the Guidelines of the Industrial Training Policy for Evaluation.You are requested to go through the following points carefully so as to avoid any miscommunication: 1) You dont have to prepare the Spiral bound Training Report. 2) You have to prepare your log book with formats attached ,and get it signed by your supervisor on daily or weekly basis and finally get it signed and stamped by training manager. 3) You have to paste the photocopy of your completion certificate in the starting of the log book and you can carry along your original completion certificate for the consideration of the evaluation panel. 4) You have to make a power point presentation of your hotel with 15-20 slides. 5) You should check in the Policy attached,it has been mentioned that you have to identify any problem in the hotel and give suggestions regarding that.You have to write about 4-5 pages in your log book in the end and get it checked by training Manager. 6) Kindly make sure that you collect your completion certificate and the performance appraisal form from your training manager at the time of completion of your Industrial Training. 7) For those students who are doing training in hotels make sure that it should be mentioned on their certificate that they have completed their training of 24 Weeks ie 1600 hrs. The same has been informed to your training manager also. 8) The dates of the Industrial Training Evaluation are as follows: a) B.Sc Hotel Management,Section R1902(V8906)- 4th August at 09:30am in Block No 16-201. b) B.Sc Airlines,Tourism & Hospitality ,Section R1904(V8908)-5th August at 09:30am in Block No 16-201. 9) Kindly make sure that you appear in complete uniform as per standards. I hope above mentioned information is clear to you.Please do not hesitate to get in touch in case you need any clarifications. Geetika Joshi Training Coordinator,LSH geetika.joshi@lpu.co.in Authorized By: Office of HOD Department of Hotel Management Division of Lovely School of Hospitality

body: A workshop entitled “Workshop on Gene Cloning by MERCK”, is being organized from 1/08/11 to 04/08/11, in the Department of Biotechnology, LPU. Interested students are required to send their Applications/Query to Dr. Akshay Garg (akshay.garg@lpu.co.in) latest by today. Participants will get certificate from MERCK. Following methodologies are incorporated in the workshop: Genomic DNA isolation, Insert preparation by PCR, Vector preparation, Ligation, Transformation, Plasmid DNA isolation, and Restriction digest analysis. The participation fee is Rs 3000/- per student. The participants are required to arrange their own accommodation as no hostel facility will be provided. title: Here is an opportunity to share your innovativeness. (5/10/2011)
body: LPU has come a long way due to the support of the Students, facilitation by the Staff & Faculty members and patronage by the University. At this moment we are nearing completion of yet another academic cycle to witness the influx of freshers for Admissions 2011-12. For our advertisement drive, both in the Print and Air Media we have been deploying , almost a standard format in the past to attract the best talents to the programmes offered by our University. We intend to deviate from this practice by seeking participation by our Students to generate catchy and innovative advertisement material. Towards above, the Division of Student Affairs invites participation by students to generate innovative, catchy & appropriate advertisements both for the ‘Print Media’ and for ‘Airing on the Radio’. The material for the advertisement can be taken from the content of advertisements attached. It is not necessary to use the complete data contained in the advertisements and the innovator may use any input from the attachments to his/her liking. Interested students are required to register their entry by May 15, 2011 by calling up Mr Bineet @ 8146752203. The completed project is to be submitted with the DSA, Block 27 Room No 203 by May 20, 2011. Best three entries in each of the two categories will be suitably rewarded. An entry/idea finding its way to the Media will be rewarded with an appropriate cash award. Attachments: 1. Sample Ad 1_May 10th.pdf 2. Sample Ad 2_May 10th.pdf Authorized By: Office of Deputy Director Division of Student Affairs

title: Incubation Center- LSECA……..an initiative to tap engineering talent of LPU students (5/2/2011)
body: In the recent techfest “INVICTUS11” organized by Department of Computer Applications on 15th & 16th April’11, many innovative projects/models were showcased in the “Project-O-Holic” event. All these projects were made by students with guidance of faculty in some cases. Students participating in this event were found very innovative and passionate about their projects. Considering the fact that Development of Innovative projects has always been an integral part of engineering education as it enables students to apply their subject knowledge to solve current problems. Also, there may be many students who are having better ideas but they may not be coming forward due to lack of awareness, guidance, opportunities or required resources. With this belief, Department of Computer Applications, LSECA would be coordinating a new initiative under the guidance of Honorable Pro Chancellor by name of “Incubation Center” which aims to tap the engineering talent of LPU students. In this initiative, University will assist students in overcoming all kind of hurdles in their project. The assistance may include: • Hardware/Software Resources • Expert Guidance • Availability of labs/workshops with extended timings • Services which need to be outsourced etc.. Note: All this assistance will be requiring approval on project to project basis. To Start with, we have following projects: New Projects to be started: • Car with Innovative Steering Mechanism • Anti Burglary System for Vehicle Parking Projects already being undertaken by Students: • Wiz Expert System…(based on Artificial Intelligence) • Buddy Circle (Social Networking) • Optizmized7 Who Can Join? - Any LPU student, irrespective of his/her stream can be part of this initiative in one or more projects. If you have any other Project in your mind, you are most welcome to join this initiative. For any queries, you can also contact:- Mr Rajeev Kanday (9888235282) (rajeev.13544@lpu.co.in) Ms Mandeep Kaur(9988533109) (mandeep.13695@lpu.co.in) Authorized By: Office of HOD Deptt: Computer Applications

title: Schedule for the PEP Classes in Summer Vacations (4/29/2011)
body: As per the provisions of Placement Policy 2011-12, the PEP sessions would be held in summer vacations. The total length of PEP sessions during vacations would be about 2 weeks. Two identical PEP vacations would be held – First one immediately after End Term Examinations and Second one 2 weeks before the classes resume in August 2011. For the sake of facilitating students, these sessions have been divided into 2 modules each. Thus each of these 2 sessions would have 2 modules (M1 and M2). Every student who is required to attend these sessions will have to attend both of these modules. However for the sake of convenience, students have the flexibility to attend these modules in the sequence or manner that suits them. Thus students can attend the 2 modules in one session itself or one module each in either of the 2 sessions in any sequence. The essence of this scheme is to ensure that the students get flexibility to attend PEP sessions and plan their holidays and training accordingly. This has been done to ensure that students attend the summer PEP sessions which are mandatory in nature. IT MAY BE NOTED THAT FAILURE TO ATTEND MANDATORY SUMMER CYCLE PEP SESSIONS WOULD RESULT IN PERMANENT DISQUALIFICATION FROM ENTIRE PLACEMENT PROCESS. The streams for which PEP sessions would be held in summer vacations are listed below: B.Com B.Pharmacy B.Pharmacy (Ayurveda) B.TECH B.TECH (HONS.) BBA BCA BCA(Hons) DIPLOMA M. Sc ( CSE)/Computer Application M.Com M.Pharmacy M.Pharmacy (Ayurveda) M. Sc (H) CSE/Computer Application M.TECH MBA MBA(HONS.) title: ATTENTION ALL STUDENTS (4/28/2011)
body: All Lovelyites are requested to maintain calm and not believe baseless rumors floated by some anti-social elements trying to encash on the unfortunate situation and serve their ulterior motives. Looting of kiosks, pelting stones, damaging property and staff vehicles is not an appropriate homage or tribute to our student, Johny F Lalhmangaihzuala. Even the vehicle arranged by the University to carry the students accompanying the deceased student was damaged by miscreants. You are urged not to engage in any act of violence or spreading rumors creating tension and panic. Gestures of students like wearing of face masks, assembling in groups and raising slogans will be taken as a reflection of their mal-intentions. Strict disciplinary action will be taken against the students found involved in such activities directly or indirectly. Giving irresponsible comments through any medium, instigating others and supporting miscreants in any manner will invite strict action. The students who are staying back in the hostels are urged to maintain absolute decorum and cooperate with the University authorities to safeguard everyone. Any non-cooperation from students in this regard will compel the authorities to initiate steps to evacuate the hostels too. Management and Staff Members of LPU

title: Online Hostel Allotment for the session 2011-12. (4/25/2011)
body: In order to facilitate the hostel allotment efficiently and manage the group booking (i.e. allocation of hostel for two or more than two students collectively) Hostel Allotment for the session 2011-2012 will be done online (through UMS) as per the below mentioned process: 1) Booking for Girls hostel will start on 25th April 2011 from 5.30 pm onwards till 29th April 2011 up to 05.00 pm and booking of Boys’ hostel will start on 26th April 2011 from 5.30 pm onwards till 29th April 2011 up to 05.30 p.m. The balance seats ( vacant seats and the seats cancelled due to the non payment of the hostel fee) can again be offered for booking .The announcement will be flashed on your UMS for the second round of hostel booking after 23rd May 2011. 2) The International Students , MBA (Hons) students will not participate in the Hostel online Allotment process and it will be done through their department co-ordinators. 3) The students will not be able to change the room once it is booked i.e. once room has been allotted, student will not be able to De-allocate and change the room/seater. 4) All students are advised not to share their UMS Password with anyone because in case their password is known to someone else, the room/seat may be booked against their name by someone else and once room is booked it cannot be changed or de-allocated. So it is advised not to share password and in case you have already shared the password, you are suggested to change it. 5) Students should go through all the Annexures attached in detail before exercising the hostel facility online ANNEXURE 1 : Hostel Room seater pattern with Facilities available and Revised Fee Structure ( The 5 seater is not available) ANNEXURE 2 : Step by Step Guidelines for online Hostel Booking on UMS ANNEXURE 3 : Mode of payment of hostel fees, Hostel Fee Deposit Slip and Bank Account Details 6) Fee Submission: i) The Fee for the Hostel Facility has to be submitted on or before 10th May 2011 ii) In case of students availing Bank Loan the last day of Hostel Fee submission is 20th May 2011 i.e. Bank Draft should be submitted on or before 20th May 2011. In case of ONLINE mode of payment, the students will give the details of transaction as per Annexure 3 attached ( Mode of Payment of Hostel Fees) before 10th May 2011. 7) If the details of hostel fee paid is not received by 10th May 2011 the booking for the hostels will be automatically cancelled. 8) No request will be entertained once the hostel allotment process is over, however under exceptional circumstances request may be processed with the late hostel Fee subject to the availability of seats after the approval of competent higher authority. 9) The students will be able to book the seats as per the schedule mentioned in the point one (i.e 25th April to 29th April 2011). However they can view the available rooms on the UMS interface and plan for their bookings accordingly. *Incase of Any Enquiry during the official hours 9.00 a.m – 05.00 p.m : Contact Person : 1. Ms Shivani Sharda Room No : 407, Block : 30 Contact Number : 01824 - 510306 2. Ms Sunita Sharma - 9780036436 Attachment: 1. Annexture_ 1_April 19.zip 2. Annexture 2_April 19.doc 3. Annexure 3_April 19.zip Authorized By: The Pro Chancellor.
